reason: Modelled from the Benewake TFmini-S product manual: 9-byte 0x59 0x59 frame (little-endian distance cm, strength, temp = raw/8-256 C, sum8 checksum) streamed at 100 Hz, 115200 baud; driver resyncs, verifies checksum, flags 65535/65534/65532 distances and implements the 0x5A command frames. Part check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico (D=237cm S=850 T=41.5C, PCB DRC clean) on the first run.
